scope: Focused desktop 1920x1080 Vulkan baseline on the pinned0.5.0 binary. Existing city exterior/riverside/island routes; not a dedicated lab-interior route, mission proof or physical input test. No other task-owned GPU/player/CPU-heavy job is permitted.
power: Per-job AC/power-profile snapshots are retained below; this audit did not change the power profile.

cache_observations.policy: Fresh XDG directories do not imply a fully cold shader/driver/PSO cache; Unity shared its actual /tmp cache across runs.

limitations: City covers five exterior waypoints (alley/main gate/staff terminal/service entrance/return); no dedicated lab-interior, close-up character or free-amoeba camera performance baseline was collected.
Riverside uses a Peace chapter fixture; island seeds travel/arrival/service-gate/refuge prerequisites and tours as a maintenance host. These are benchmark setup, not mission completion evidence.
Frame and profiler samples exclude startup and screenshot encoding. These runs do not measure loading/startup spikes, menu/video playback or every gameplay view.

GPU frame time is unavailable; valid CPU/wait markers are nested and cannot be added or relabeled as GPU-only work. The derived60FPS margin is observed total-frame p99 margin, not a GPU upgrade budget.

The Unity graphics-driver memory reading is zero/unavailable. NVML memory is total device usage including desktop/driver/other GPU clients, not per-player residency or a complete per-game VRAM budget.
NVML one-second telemetry covers each whole job, including startup, screenshots and shutdown; its samples are not the profiler walk-window distribution.

The riverHigh worst frame217.1ms is retained. Aggregate Main/PlayerLoop maxima are about217ms and render-thread-wait max213.276ms; their maxima are not frame-aligned evidence. No GC samples or per-frame hitch timestamps were collected, so a specific cause remains unproven.

Each job has fresh XDGconfig/cache directories, but the actual Unity VulkanPSO cache loaded from a shared/tmp path and grew across jobs. No fully cold-cache or cache-order-independent comparison is claimed.

All recorded profile samples are focused on the real desktop. Window focus was set only for the exact owned benchmark window without keyboard/mouse injection. No physical input or continuous human playthrough is claimed.
Saved screenshots are identity/hash evidence here, not a claim of new art quality or controlled before/after lighting/weather comparisons.
These measurements apply to the pinned0.5.0 candidate and recorded power profile. They do not predict performance after source changes or on every district view.
